<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Get pixel counts for pos 0 cycle symbols
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# First ensure cursor is at pos 0 (leftmost)
# Cursor should be at (48, 15) which is pos 0 area
# Get current pos 0 symbol
def get_pink_at_col(col_range):
    for node in seg['nodes']:
        if node['color'] == 'B':
            b = node['boundary']
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if 50 <= min_row <= 55 and col_range[0] <= min_col <= col_range[1]:
                return {'hash': node['hash'][:8], 'pixels': node['pixels'], 'col': min_col}
    return None

# Get pos 0 current
pos0 = get_pink_at_col((14, 18))
print(f"Pos 0 initial: {pos0}")

# Cycle pos 0 and record all hashes + pixel counts
cycle_data = []
start_hash = pos0['hash']
cycle_data.append({'hash': start_hash, 'pixels': pos0['pixels']})

for i in range(10):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    sym = get_pink_at_col((14, 18))
    if sym:
        cycle_data.append(sym)
        if sym['hash'] == start_hash and len(cycle_data) > 1:
            cycle_data = cycle_data[:-1]
            break

print(f"Pos 0 full cycle ({len(cycle_data)}):")
for cd in cycle_data:
    print(f"  hash={cd['hash']}, pixels={cd['pixels']}")

# Blue strip pixel counts: 13, 11, 15, 15, 11
# Check if pos 0 can reach 13px (blue pos 0)
pos0_pixels = [cd['pixels'] for cd in cycle_data]
print(f"\nPos 0 pixel counts: {pos0_pixels}")
print(f"Blue pos 0 needs 13px: {13 in pos0_pixels}")
</parameter>
</function>

<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Get pixel counts for pos 0 cycle symbols
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# First ensure cursor is at pos 0 (leftmost)
# Cursor should be at (48, 15) which is pos 0 area
# Get current pos 0 symbol
def get_pink_at_col(col_range):
    for node in seg['nodes']:
        if node['color'] == 'B':
            b = node['boundary']
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in b)
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in b)
            if 50 <= min_row <= 55 and col_range[0] <= min_col <= col_range[1]:
                return {'hash': node['hash'][:8], 'pixels': node['pixels'], 'col': min_col}
    return None

# Get pos 0 current
pos0 = get_pink_at_col((14, 18))
print(f"Pos 0 initial: {pos0}")

# Cycle pos 0 and record all hashes + pixel counts
cycle_data = []
start_hash = pos0['hash']
cycle_data.append({'hash': start_hash, 'pixels': pos0['pixels']})

for i in range(10):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    sym = get_pink_at_col((14, 18))
    if sym:
        cycle_data.append(sym)
        if sym['hash'] == start_hash and len(cycle_data) > 1:
            cycle_data = cycle_data[:-1]
            break

print(f"Pos 0 full cycle ({len(cycle_data)}):")
for cd in cycle_data:
    print(f"  hash={cd['hash']}, pixels={cd['pixels']}")

# Blue strip pixel counts: 13, 11, 15, 15, 11
# Check if pos 0 can reach 13px (blue pos 0)
pos0_pixels = [cd['pixels'] for cd in cycle_data]
print(f"\nPos 0 pixel counts: {pos0_pixels}")
